additionalDocuments.label: SAMANA Ivy Gardens 2 · original official brochure and home drawings

review.imagery: Nineteen own-project renders were visually reviewed. Seventeen native brochure scenes and two distinct current-gallery angles cover the complete tower, plot, podium, private-balcony outlook, lobby, home interiors and leisure spaces. Generic people/technology/car photographs and repeated crops are excluded. The complete tower supplies the card and hero. Proposed views and fitout are unit-unspecific. The page 24 scene is a bathroom vanity, not a kitchen.
review.floorPlans: Five home drawings come from the official brochure and eight complete building sheets from the official floorplate pack. The brochure includes a three-bedroom maid-room layout beyond the current page’s four home categories. Floor 35 lists a separate three-bedroom category, while floor 34 lists three bedrooms with maid. Unit matching and numerical areas require confirmation. Floor 17 is not listed in the supplied pack. All five official home sheets on physical pages 33–37 and all eight official floorplates on pages 2–9 were visually reviewed. Page 3’s exact typical-floor grouping excludes 11, 17, 21 and 31. Special floor groups and the complete retail footprint remain visible. No numerical area is inferred from the generic category minimum.
review.location: Complete original brochure travel panel page 9 and regional map page 10 were visually reviewed. Source-range conflicts remain explicit. The primary coordinate 25.100574589459143, 55.37710037045059 is recorded with source hash and six-place rounding. No exact entrance, live route, journey distance or current metro service is inferred.
review.provenance: Primary HTML, original official brochure, duplicate official asset brochure and official floorplates retain receipts and hashes. The brochure’s page 7 copy names Lake Views 2 and is excluded from project claims. Native image origins, original document bytes, complete sheets and physical source links remain available. Protected ownership and completed text research are preserved.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific areas, approved home-to-unit mapping, a floor-17 sheet, current availability of the brochure’s three-bedroom variant, final fitout, a verified visitor entrance and dated construction photographs were not established.
